body:
DELIVERY VERDICT: feasible as a production-path guarded pilot, not as the report's implied simple greenfield MVP. The 10-step list is not a schedule. Critical path is uncertainty retirement -> contracts/fault harness -> safe prepared-deck slice + authoritative realtime -> private AI -> guarded publication -> pilot hardening. Do not commit live public web evidence or automatic placement to the first pilot.

STAFF/TIMELINE: with 5 core FTE (TS/frontend, realtime/backend, Python/ingestion, AI/eval, QA/automation) plus part-time security/privacy/ops: 13-16 weeks to guarded pilot. With 3 generalists: 20-26 weeks OR cut live-public AI and Window Management. Any materially shorter estimate is a demo estimate, not production readiness. Scarce skills assumed by report: Korean speech/eval design, distributed-state/WSS property testing, browser multi-display/PWA lifecycle, RLS/security, office-document rendering, privacy/vendor deletion. Name owners before kickoff.

EXECUTABLE PACKAGES / EXIT EVIDENCE:
WP0 Feasibility evidence (2w, no deps): >=3 representative Korean decks (fonts/charts/tables/image-heavy) ingest with no blocking fidelity defect; frozen annotated Korean corpus selects STT or live STT is cut; >=100-claim verifier spike records false-SUPPORT/yield/p95; real Windows+projector proves manual extended and mirror flow; venue-like WSS baseline; two-origin auth/session spike. STOP if any core mode has no viable fallback.
WP1 Contracts + deterministic harness (1w, after WP0 decisions): closed shared schemas; pure reducer for revision/epoch/idempotency; record/replay simulator covers duplicate/out-of-order/gap/reconnect; two independently deployed builds pass schema/canary CI. Choose coordinator here, not by stack fashion.
WP2 Prepared-deck safe slice (2w): canonical local uploader/viewer; manual Tier-0 two-screen flow; preapproved cards publish/revoke/expire; 20-minute target-hardware rehearsal; public noninterference proven by endpoint/topic/credential allowlists + static bundle scan + bounded differential audience traces under varied private inputs. Canary search alone is insufficient.
WP3 Authoritative control + mirror (2-3w, parallel with WP2 after WP1): WSS commands/snapshots pass property/fault suite; authenticated non-authorizing pair_id phone flow; takeover atomically increments epoch and old traffic rejects; 30-minute fault soak yields exactly-once visible effects. Protocol harness must pass before pairing UI.
WP4 Private live assistant (2-3w, after WP0+WP2): final transcript+slide triggers; ACL-first retrieval passes cross-tenant/revoke tests; frozen-corpus recommendation p95<=5s; timeout/failure abstains and cannot affect Stage.
WP5 Guarded public evidence (2w, after WP3+WP4; feature OFF until gate): fixed >=400 representative/adversarial claim corpus; zero critical false-SUPPORT and Wilson 95% upper bound <1% (adjust only via explicit product risk decision); rights/DLP explicit allowlist; source revision/hash/ACL rechecked; approve/retract/stale/tombstone E2E; approval/retract accepted->Stage p95<=500ms. If not met, ship private candidate + preapproved public library only.
WP6 Enhancement/pilot hardening (2-3w): Window Management only now; manual fallback survives denial/unplug/fullscreen exit; offline shell does not imply AI availability; 320px/200%/keyboard/screen-reader/forced-colors; security/load/runbook/preflight; 3 full rehearsals on target hardware/network with zero unrecoverable failures.

IRREVERSIBLE DEFAULTS: separate public/private origins/builds and WSS data plane; Stage itself performs fullscreen click; existing authenticated Console pairs phone, then public Stage opens; one logical coordinator may use same repo/cluster but public projection needs distinct deployable credential/topic/store reachability; canonical versioned deck bundle is the shared identity root; live-public AI stays feature-flagged.

GO/NO-GO: Go from WP0 only if deck fidelity, manual two-screen flow, and venue WSS are viable and private-only AI has acceptable STT/verifier signal. Go to WP5 only after numeric quality and approval-usability thresholds exist. No-go on live-public AI if corpus gate fails; no-go on pilot if public reachability or replay/takeover invariants fail. Automatic placement and post-report never block the core pilot.

CROSS-CRITIQUE: Scope critic's same-origin BroadcastChannel/demo-auth cut is a valid 2-3 week throwaway feasibility demo, not shippable MVP: it violates the intended boundary, omits mirror mode, and causes a production rewrite. One deck and canary scan are inadequate. Logic critic's invariants are sound after making them decidable: replace 'arbitrary inputs' with bounded generative differential tests; vendor deletion needs provider receipt taxonomy + blocking exception; define tombstone retention/SLO; split authority—Stage-observed absolute slide position can reconcile after reconnect, while server remains command/controller authority and relative offline commands never replay. Systems critic's clever neutral-launcher fork is not worth milestone time absent a 1-click contract; default to the report's safer two-step cross-origin flow. Product risk: first-pilot promise should be 'reliable private assistance + preapproved public evidence', not live web publication.

RESIDUAL RISKS: provider pricing/free-tier sleep is operational noise but demo-day prewarm/runbook is mandatory; deletion receipts may be unavailable; external origin fetch yield may be too low even with acceptable false-support; presenter approval may overload the speaker; school network/proxy behavior cannot be simulated fully; legal retention/consent language needs counsel/product owner. These are explicit gates, not backlog footnotes.
